text: $SHOP grew revenue 32% and delivered a 22% free cash flow margin, but sales slightly missed estimates. Q4 gross profit is guided to grow more slowly than revenue. The question is how much of that sales growth converts into profit.
source_title: Shopify shares fall after strong sales growth and a softer profit outlook; a separate filing allows future share and debt sales.
